description: Defines the ProductType entity class mapped to a database table, with fields for product type code and whether adding to cart is allowed. Implements auditing and identification functionality.

classes.name: ProductType
classes.description: Entity class representing product types with properties like code and add-to-cart permissions, including auditing features.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the product type.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information associated with this entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this entity.

methods.name: isAllowAddToCart
methods.description: Indicates whether adding this product type to cart is permitted.

methods.name: setAllowAddToCart
methods.description: Defines whether adding this product type to cart is allowed.
